verdict.rationale: Factory's API reference explicitly supports creating and driving Droid sessions including sending messages within an active session (factory-docs-13), and the CLI is interactive by nature, implying follow-up prompts are possible without restarting. However, there is no explicit documentation describing mid-task interruption/steering while the agent is actively executing a long-running task (e.g., Missions or droid exec), so the steering-while-running behavior is not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit docs on interrupting/redirecting an in-progress autonomous run, and independent/hands-on confirmation that follow-up messages actually steer ongoing work rather than queue for the next turn.
